entries.description: A quicker, smoother app on every phone

changelog.title: Improved
items: LuvLyrics opens faster, especially the first few times after an update
Screens redraw less while music plays, so scrolling and the player feel smoother
Animations and swipes are steadier on Android

entries.description: A cleaner player slide, a steadier return to the app, and tidier lyric defaults

changelog.title: Fixed
items: Opening and closing the player is now a clean slide. The cover no longer jumps across the screen
Coming back to the app keeps your place and shows Play, instead of a retry button
Tapping a song after reopening the app plays it straight away
Import and Blend pages now have the same soft cover glow as the rest of the app, with no stray coloured band

changelog.title: Improved
items: The Import page now explains both ways to bring your Spotify music
New installs and Reset now start lyrics at size 24, line by line, with tight spacing
New playlist and Import from Spotify are now in the Library menu (the three dots), so the playlists page is cleaner

entries.description: A much smaller download, with the same features

changelog.title: Improved
items: The app is about 30 MB smaller to download and install
Removed an unused part that only older builds of Your DJ needed

entries.description: Checking for updates works on a weak signal, and you can always download the latest version

changelog.title: Fixed
items: Checking for updates tries again once before it gives up, so a weak signal no longer shows the update server as down
The website's Android download now gives you the latest version, not an older one

changelog.title: Improved
items: When the check fails, Updates offers to download the latest version straight away
